title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: FYI, I asked Colangelo and Al if I can talk to you for a story. I’m doing a feature on what the “new normal” is for Tigers people. Not looking for “answers” or a medical expertise, more like how the shutdown has affected your job
I just wanted to let you know. I figured it would be best to just go through them first

Anthony I appreciate you following those steps but I really don’t want to do any interviews.  I just don’t want my name in the paper.  I’ll always talk to you for info purposes but not as the guy in the article
That’s totally fine. I just didn’t want you to be like, why didn’t he ask me first
